description: This file defines safe numeric conversion functions and classes, including checked_cast, saturated_cast, strict_cast, and the StrictNumeric class, with support for range checking, NaN handling, and compile-time safety in numeric conversions.

classes.name: StrictNumeric
classes.description: A template class for compile-time range checking between numeric types, wrapping assignment operations in a strict_cast.

methods.name: IsValueInRangeForNumericType
methods.description: Checks if a value is within the valid range for a specified numeric type.

methods.name: IsValueNegative
methods.description: Determines if a numeric value is negative, with specialization for signed and unsigned types.

methods.name: checked_cast
methods.description: Performs a cast that checks for overflow or underflow, with runtime verification.

methods.name: saturated_cast
methods.description: Performs a cast that saturates on overflow or underflow, with optional NaN handling.

methods.name: strict_cast
methods.description: Performs a compile-time safe cast that fails if the destination type cannot contain the source value.
